name: Karta.io Business Corporate Visa
summary: A high-scale corporate card solution for Web3 teams and media buyers, supporting up to 500 active virtual cards with US-based BINs.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only, no physical card

faq.question: Does the Karta.io Business Corporate Visa charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No. There is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Karta.io Business Corporate Visa?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Karta.io Business Corporate Visa require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
